chapter: Ben Webster, Tatum and Los Angeles scene
title: Lester's nicknames and being the only white man in the band
summary: Lester called him Gray Boy; he was the only white player and was teased about a conk.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Lester was a great one for putting names on people.
Oh, good Lord. He used to call me Gray Boy.
You weren't the only one in the band.

Yeah. Everybody else was... He'd say "You're gray, I'm Oxford gray." And I was the only White guy in the whole band, so I used to get it from all angles. They were going to take me uptown all the time and give me...what did they call that?...give me a gas from my hair.... They were going to put the gas on first.
And then put conk on it to make it straight, and all that stuff. They were always going to take me uptown to give me a gas. [CHUCKLES]
